summary: Phase-2 Data-tab CRUD tested end-to-end. Added 12 new backend tests to backend_test.py (auto-seed of 4 demo rows, POST/PATCH/DELETE + 404 + cross-user isolation + per-project scoping). All 38 backend tests pass. Frontend verified via Playwright: rows load, cell edit via data-input-0-name persists across reload, data-add-row persists, data-del-N persists after reload. Regression smoke: /project/:id workspace loads with plan + preview tab OK.
critical_code_review_comments: DataRow.mrr stored as string; consider int for consistency with the pro-mode 'int' hint shown in the table header.

DataTab.jsx delRow uses row index in data-testid (data-del-{r}) which changes after any insertion/deletion — that's expected in tests but can be surprising; consider stable id-based testids for future tests.
Auto-seed on GET is convenient but has a subtle race: two parallel GETs on an empty project could each insert 4 rows. Consider an upsert or unique index.
test_credentials: Bearer test_session_seed_01 / user_testseed01 (re-seeded in TestDataRows.setup_class since prior TestLogout invalidates a session).
seed_data_creation: Created two throwaway projects via API during UI test; each auto-seeded 4 demo customer rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Data-tab CRUD is real and fully covered. If tests are run standalone, TestDataRows.setup_class re-upserts TOKEN_1 session so ordering with TestLogout is safe.
